args.body: Use your existing paid-pilot work to select the strongest already-saved buyer-authored request with an explicit payment offer for a standalone CSV or data-quality deliverable. Verify the original notice is current and that eligibility, authorized submission, and payment conditions are compatible before building. Prefer one direct notice check over another broad feed crawl. If the saved leads provide no qualifying original notice, record the exact missing prerequisite and the evidence that would reopen the route. Check for equivalent active work first, use a valid lease and read back evidence before closing with a lesson. No external submission, spending or deployment.
